channel.title: Jody Ritonga — Security Research
channel.description: Public CVE records and coordinated vulnerability disclosures by Jody Ritonga.

item.title: CVE-2026-95321: UI misrepresentation in Chrome Payments
item.description: A user-interface misrepresentation issue in the Payments component of Chrome before 154.0.8037.57 could allow a remote attacker to spoof payment UI via a crafted HTML page. Rated Medium by Google.

item.title: CVE-2026-91717: Missing authorization in Chrome for Android
item.description: A missing authorization issue in Chrome for Android before 153.0.8010.47 could allow a local attacker with a co-installed app to obtain sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-43713: Permission restriction issue in Safari and Apple platforms
item.description: A permissions issue affecting Safari and multiple Apple platforms was addressed with additional restrictions.

item.title: CVE-2026-12323: DOM and HTML spoofing issue in Firefox
item.description: A spoofing issue in the DOM Core and HTML component was fixed in Firefox 152 and Thunderbird 152.

item.title: CVE-2026-40416: UI misrepresentation and network spoofing in Microsoft Edge
item.description: A user-interface misrepresentation issue could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-35429: UI misrepresentation and network spoofing in Edge for Android
item.description: A user-interface misrepresentation issue in Edge for Android could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform spoofing.

item.title: CVE-2026-33119: UI misrepresentation and network spoofing in Edge for Android
item.description: A user-interface misrepresentation issue in Edge for Android could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform spoofing.
